_doc: Character bible — the single source of truth for every recurring character across ALL chapters. Each character has ONE unique, positive, HARD, shape-based signature (readable in grayscale) so it reproduces consistently on prompt-only FLUX and stays distinct from the others. Chapter scripts sync their cast from here (evaluate.mjs --sync-cast) so descriptions never drift between chapters. Rule: distinguish by a UNIQUE signature's presence, never by hairstyle or by the absence of a feature.

victor.name: Victor
victor.canonical: a thin young man, round head, neat short dark hair, small round glasses, plain shirt
victor.anchor: small round glasses and a plain work apron
victor.consistency: the ONLY character with round glasses + apron and a bare head; keep hair short and neat, never a hat.

creature.name: the Creature
creature.signature: tall gaunt bald ghoul, black hollow eyes, jagged teeth
creature.canonical: a very tall gaunt BALD creature, chalk-white skin, huge black hollow eyes, sharp jagged teeth, ragged shirt
creature.anchor: a tall gaunt bald chalk-white body, black hollow eyes and jagged teeth
creature.consistency: always the TALLEST, lankiest figure; bald with sunken black eye-sockets and a jagged-tooth mouth; never a hat or hair.

clerval.name: Clerval
clerval.canonical: a cheerful young man who always wears a black top hat and a black coat
clerval.anchor: a black top hat and black coat
clerval.consistency: the ONLY character in a top hat; always cheerful; the top hat belongs to him alone.

elizabeth.name: Elizabeth
elizabeth.canonical: a gentle young woman wearing a white bonnet over a long braid, with a shoulder shawl
elizabeth.anchor: a white bonnet and a shoulder shawl
elizabeth.consistency: the ONLY character in a bonnet; a woman with a long braid and shawl; never glasses and never an apron (those belong to Victor).

alphonse.name: Alphonse
alphonse.canonical: an elderly gentleman with a long white beard leaning on a walking cane
alphonse.anchor: a long white beard and a walking cane
alphonse.consistency: the ONLY elderly figure; long white beard and a cane; no hat.

ernest.name: Ernest
ernest.canonical: a teenage boy wearing a flat newsboy cap, no glasses
ernest.consistency: the ONLY character in a flat cap; a younger teen; no glasses and no apron.

justine.name: Justine
justine.canonical: a sweet frank-faced young servant girl in a white servant's cap
justine.consistency: the ONLY character in a small white servant's cap.

william.name: William
william.canonical: a small cherubic boy with dimples wearing a little sailor cap
william.consistency: the only small child; sailor cap and dimples.

waldman.name: Waldman
waldman.canonical: a kindly old professor, bald on top with a long grey beard and a gown
waldman.anchor: a bald head with a long grey beard and a professor's gown
waldman.consistency: kindly elderly professor, grey beard + gown; distinct from Krempe by warmth and a longer beard.

krempe.name: Krempe
krempe.canonical: a short squat gruff professor in a curly powdered wig, scowling
krempe.anchor: a curly powdered wig and a squat scowling build
krempe.consistency: short, squat, scowling, in a powdered wig; distinct from Waldman by build and wig.
